titles.zh: 楷书玄妙观重修三门记卷
titles.en: Draft of the Record of the Three Gates

productionDate.note: The museum dates the scroll to the fourteenth century and records no writing year.

currentCollection.note: The museum catalogues the scroll as TB-1461 in its East Asian calligraphy section. Neither record states how or when the scroll entered the collection.
currentCollection.noteZh: 馆方将其编入东洋书法类，机构管理序号 TB-1461。两处均未记入藏经过与年份。

review.note: Draft object record from two museum records read on 2026-11-23. The accession history and the scroll's measurements are not stated; the object was not examined.
review.noteZh: 草稿实物记录，依据 2026-11-23 阅读的两处馆方著录整理。入藏经过与尺寸均未记载；未核对原件。

notes: No dimensions are recorded because neither museum record gives them.
The object number TB-1461 is an institutional management number, not a Chinese-style accession number for a rubbing; it is recorded verbatim.
No transfer event is recorded: the museum states neither a former owner nor an acquisition year.
notesZh: 两处馆方著录均未给尺寸，故不记。
TB-1461 为机构管理序号，非中国式拓本登录号；此处照录。
不设递藏事件：馆方未记旧藏家，也未记入藏年份。
